message.content:
Berlin is **9 hours ahead** of Los Angeles.

| City | Standard Time | Daylight‑Saving Time |
|------|---------------|---------------------|
| Los Angeles | Pacific Standard Time (UTC‑08:00) | Pacific Daylight Time (UTC‑07:00) |
| Berlin | Central European Time (UTC+01:00) | Central European Summer Time (UTC+02:00) |

Because both regions adjust their clocks by the same amount each year, the time difference stays constant at **+9 hours**.  

Example:  
- When it’s 12:00 PM noon in Los Angeles, it’s 9:00 PM the same day in Berlin.  
- When it’s 6:00 AM in Los Angeles, it’s 3:00 PM in Berlin.
